enabled.description: Whether to start the gdnsd server and listen for queries.

listen_addrs.description: List of IP addresses and ports to listen on for DNS traffic.

address.description: IP address to bind to (IPv4 or IPv6).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout.

log_level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, notice, warn, or error.

chroot.description: Directory to chroot to after startup (empty string disables chroot).

user.description: User to drop privileges to after startup.

group.description: Group to drop privileges to after startup.

workers.description: Number of worker threads (0 = automatic based on CPU count).

max_udp_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of UDP packets to accept.

tcp_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for idle TCP connections.

max_tcp_connections.description: Maximum TCP connections allowed per worker thread.

auto_reload.description: Whether to automatically reload zones when their files change.

reload_interval.description: Maximum interval (in seconds) between zone checks for changes.

file.description: Path to zone file, relative to zones.root. Defaults to zone.name + .zone.

dnssec.description: DNSSEC signing and validation settings (disabled by default).

enabled.description: Enable DNSSEC for all served zones.

keys_dir.description: Directory containing DNSSEC private keys for signing.

rrsig_ttl.description: Default TTL (in seconds) for RRSIG records.

access_control.description: Client IP-based access control (disabled by default).

default.description: Default action for unmatched clients: allow, deny, or ignore.

rules.description: Ordered list of access control rules.

action.description: Action for matching clients: allow or deny.

client.description: IP range in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24 or ::1).
